card.name: Units after large round numbers
card.fires_on: The unit word right after a big number, such as gallons after 'million' or year/years after '130,000'. Seen in general web text on water use and ancient dates.

modes.label: Gallons after million
modes.description: The word gallon(s) follows a number like 'million' or '700,000' in water or fuel volumes.
modes.example: from 1.3 million gallons per day in 2010 to 10.4 million<< gallons>> per day in 2012

modes.label: Years in ages
modes.description: Year, years or ago follows a large number in an age or date in the distant past.
modes.example: From some 150 000 years<< ago>> to the present day

card.plain: It fires on the unit word that comes right after a very large number, like gallons or years.
